# MM-P1-L2-IH02 - Maintenance manual - Ring Rolling induction billet heater #2

Revision: Rev D  
Plant: P1, line P1-L2  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L2-IH02

Scope
This document provides preventive maintenance, inspection, and corrective action guidance for Ring Rolling induction billet heater #2 (EQ-P1-L2-IH02). The intent is to ensure consistent billet heating performance, safe operation, and reliable integration with the ring rolling line. Tasks described apply to the heater housing, coil assembly, cooling system, power connections, controls, and instrumentation necessary to meet process targets and safety requirements. Reference procedures and quality requirements are identified at the end of the document; consult those documents for sampling, record retention, and permit requirements.

Background and rationale
EQ-P1-L2-IH02 is a medium-frequency induction billet heater used to heat forging billets prior to ring rolling. Maintaining coil integrity, cooling capacity, and accurate temperature control is critical to achieving metallurgical targets and preventing equipment damage. The target billet temperature for Ring Rolling induction billet heater #2 (EQ-P1-L2-IH02) is 1230 °C. The coil cooling water flow minimum for Ring Rolling induction billet heater #2 (EQ-P1-L2-IH02) is 46 L/min. These values are process-critical: temperature directly affects microstructure and formability; cooling water flow prevents coil overheating and insulation failure. Maintenance tasks prioritize checks that ensure these two parameters can be reliably achieved and sustained.

Tools
- Insulated hand tools appropriate for electrical enclosure access
- Multimeter and high-voltage insulation tester for coil and bus inspections
- Portable infrared pyrometer for verification of surface temperatures and component checks related to heat soak
- Flow meter and pressure gauge for cooling loop verification (calibrate per SOP-P1-L2-02 prior to use)
- Leak detection materials and appropriate sealing compounds compatible with cooling circuit materials
- Personal protective equipment compliant with site requirements

Procedure
Preparation
- Lockout and tagout the heater power and energy sources per SOP-P1-L2-04 before opening panels or performing any work. Verify absence of hazardous energy and allow hot components to cool to safe touch levels.
- Review recent operating logs and alarm history for EQ-P1-L2-IH02 to identify recurring trends prior to disassembly.

External inspection
- Inspect external housing for deformation, signs of coolant leakage, or compromised cable entry seals. Confirm integrity of access panels and fasteners.
- Verify routing and strain relief of power and control cabling. Look for discoloration, abrasive wear, or insulation compromise.

Coil assembly and bus checks
- Visually inspect coil for surface cracks, hot spots, or displaced winding supports. Check insulation condition on coil terminations and supports.
- Perform electrical continuity and insulation resistance testing on the coil and buswork using the appropriate test adapters while following safety protocols. Record test values in the maintenance log.
- Verify mechanical retention of coil clamp blocks and supporting brackets. Replace any fasteners or supports that show deformation or looseness.

Cooling system maintenance
- Verify supply and return lines for leaks, erosion, or blockage. Clean strainers and screens in-line with the cooling supply.
- Confirm flow through the coil circuit meets or exceeds the coil cooling water flow minimum for Ring Rolling induction billet heater #2 (EQ-P1-L2-IH02) is 46 L/min at nominal pump head. Adjust valves and clean screens as required to achieve minimum flow.
- Inspect heat exchanger surfaces and pump seals for signs of contamination or degradation. Replace sealing elements showing compromise and flush the loop to remove particulate contamination.

Controls and instrumentation
- Confirm that temperature control loops and feedback sensors are free of wiring faults and properly anchored to prevent vibration-induced failure.
- Verify calibration status of temperature measurement devices used for process control; if calibration verification is required, follow SOP-P1-L2-02.
- Check interlock functionality that inhibits heater operation when coil cooling water flow falls below required minimum or when safety doors are open.

Functional verification and example checks
- After reassembly and re-energization, perform a controlled heat cycle to confirm stable operation and verify that the control system can achieve and hold the target billet temperature. The target billet temperature for Ring Rolling induction billet heater #2 (EQ-P1-L2-IH02) is 1230 °C; use process thermocouples and the control interface to confirm setpoint tracking and stability.
- Monitor coil inlet and outlet water temperature delta and flow indicator to ensure no emergent restriction; flow should not be permitted to operate below the coil cooling water flow minimum for Ring Rolling induction billet heater #2 (EQ-P1-L2-IH02) is 46 L/min.
- Example anomaly: if temperature overshoot occurs with normal flow, suspect control loop tuning or sensor placement; if temperature lag occurs, suspect reduced power transfer or clogged cooling passages.

Corrective actions
- Replace damaged coil insulation or windings in accordance with vendor repair standards. If replacement is performed, re-test insulation resistance and document before returning to service.
- Repair or replace leaking cooling components and flush system to remove particulates. Re-verify flow against the stated minimum.
- If control or sensor replacement is necessary, follow calibration procedures in SOP-P1-L2-02 before returning to production.

Acceptance criteria
- Coil mechanical condition: no visible cracks, broken supports, or loose terminations.
- Electrical insulation and continuity: no insulation test failures and continuity within vendor-specified limits as recorded in the maintenance log.
- Cooling loop performance: measured flow equals or exceeds the coil cooling water flow minimum for Ring Rolling induction billet heater #2 (EQ-P1-L2-IH02) is 46 L/min with no system leaks or observable cavitation.
- Process performance: heater must be capable of achieving and holding the target billet temperature for Ring Rolling induction billet heater #2 (EQ-P1-L2-IH02) is 1230 °C under normal operating load without tripping protective interlocks attributable to heater fault conditions.
- Instrumentation and controls: all safety interlocks and process controls function as designed and calibration records are current per SOP-P1-L2-02.

Records to keep
- Completed maintenance checklist and defect reports stored under the equipment record for EQ-P1-L2-IH02.
- Test results for insulation resistance, continuity, and cooling flow, with instrument identification and calibration references recorded per QS-PROC-02.
- Calibration certificates and replacement part receipts filed with routine maintenance records listed under SOP-P1-L2-04 for permit and safety audit traceability.
- Post-maintenance functional verification report showing achievement of the process target temperature and cooling flow acceptance criteria.

Related documents
- QS-PROC-02
- SOP-P1-L2-02
- SOP-P1-L2-04
